spiritgiven.comments:
Fouls & body contact: there were a few late plays on the game but we didn’t consider it significant to lower the spirit score

Other than that we consider that it was an excellent game and we wish them the best of lucks in the reat of the tournament

Fair-mindedness: there was one call where we thought the rules were used in their favor (so not fair-minded). But since it’s one call, we still kept the score at 2. 
Communication: some call there were reactions, but apologized after. Also, another call where they didn’t even want to communicate about the call.

The lack of rules knowledge affected calls not being resolved correctly nor in a timely manner.
There was a lot of unnecessary contact and dangerous plays. A lot of the contact continued after we spoke about it
Overall a few well spirited game

Their lack of rules knowledge affected various calls and the outcome of those calls. This is connected to fair-mindedness. In cases where they didn’t know the rules, it was used incorrectly and they benefited from this. 

Unfortunately in communication they has big reactions when we made calls and even responded very sarcastically to our double team calls.

Fair-mindedness: we felt some of the calls were resolved to favor them and/or some call were made to benefit them and stop our offense. Some calls were also made late once they saw the outcome. 
Communications: with some call there were a lot of reactions. We still scored it a 2 but was more lower end of 2

We put a 2 for contact, but it was on the lower side of two with a lot of contact on the mark. 
For fair-mindedness we put 2, but it was on the higher end of 2 since they acknowledged when calls were made but wouldn’t affected the outcome. 
Likewise with attitude around the feel was good and on the higher end of 2.

Well spirited game, for attitude and self control it was a high 2 because they maintained positivity throughout the game. Some of the double teams were called incorrectly especially when their handlers moved into the space. But great game!!

For contact we gave 2 but was on the lower side of 2. 
Communication was great and that’s why we gave it a 3

spiritreceived.comments:
Confusions about rules regarding max stalls, wrong positions after stoppage, resolution of gender ratio violations
A few rough physical contacts (elbows) during throws and skying competitions, body contacts off discs
Communication off the fields was fantastic especially with spirit captains, but not so much on the field
Very enjoyable game thanks! We appreciated your coach collecting the disc when it went out!! Watch the double team in the zone going forward

Thank you for the game!

We felt the rules knowledge and use was not quite there yet with the constant double teaming.

For fouls and body contact we felt there was contact throughout the game and one dangerous play to our player who was stationary.

Fair-minded to always check if players are ready before tapping the disc in.

We appreciated the positive attitude between each point and throughout the calls. Thank you for adjusting offsides during the game! All the best!

- amazing communication and friendliness between both team
- we did felt there were abit more body contacts throughout the whole tournament after the feedback but calls were resolved fairly quick.
